title: OpenClaw for Customer Success Teams: Automate Renewals, Health Scores, and QBRs
summary: OpenClaw automates the CS tasks that eat 40% of a CSM's week: renewal reminders, health scoring, QBR prep, churn alerts, and NPS follow-ups.
body_markdown: Not natively via a built-in connector. OpenClaw connects to APIs — so if your CSP exposes a REST API (Gainsight does; Totango does), you can write an OpenClaw tool or use its web fetch capabilities to query it. The more common approach: connect OpenClaw directly to the underlying data sources (Salesforce, Mixpanel, Stripe) rather than through the CSP layer, and let OpenClaw handle the coordination that sits above the CSP.
